notes.title: SpaceDweller 1.1 "Reassembled" Update Is Out Now!!!
notes.content:
Features:
[list]
    [*]Shoot 'em Up missions.
    [*]Tutorials.
    [*]Lore elements. Destroy enemy flagships to dicover the lore.
    [*]Free Original Soundtrack (as a DLC)
    [*]Corrupted save files fix and other bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.content:
Hey Guys! I have a great news! I am working on a big update for SpaceDweller 
that called "Reassembled". 

Update Highlights:

[list]
    [*]Shoot 'em up missions
    [*]Tutorials
